answer: One concrete defense is to make identity expensive to fake but cheap to keep: require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit at a single trusted vertex of the network, a haven where reputation accrues slowly through verified work. Sybil copies then face a real cost. Like bees drawn to nectar, cheap clones swarm in, but without staked history they cannot harvest rewards, so creating thousands of fake identities stops paying for itself.
